notes.title: Wizards:Home Coming Soon
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone! 

We are just writing to let everyone know our project is coming very, very soon.  We definitely would love to get the game out to as many people as possible. 

The game features a single player and multiplayer experience. 

See you soon!
